messages:
maria: NordicHealth's monthly invoice inv_2026_0587 failed with gateway decline code 571 (issuer blocked cross-border BIN). Card last4=1111, bin_country=US, billing_country=SE. No VAT ID on file. Can ops/recon triage?
payments-bot: alert: charge_failed invoice=inv_2026_0587 attempt=1 reason=issuer_restricted_bin gateway=stripe-eu
jon: Ops: I'll check with acquirer for BIN restrictions. If customer supplies VAT ID we'll try a retry with tax metadata.
nora: Finance: amount ~\u20ac12,875. We can approve a one-off wire fallback if manual charge fails, but need KYC and funds-release PR. Use https://internal.redwood/finance/wires.
maria: Support please request VAT ID + company registration copy before any retry. Hold revenue recognition until payment completes.
ashley: Support ticket S-9331 opened: https://zendesk.redwood/s/9331. Asked for VAT ID and registration docs, paused billing emails.
jon: Manual retry command if VAT ID provided:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/payments/retry \
  -d '{"invoice_id":"inv_2026_0587","metadata":{"tax_id":"<VAT_ID>"}}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PAYMENT_OPS_TOKEN'
```
maria: If issuer enforces geo block, proceed to wire: change invoice.payment_method to 'wire', set status to 'pending_manual_payment' and attach docs. Finance to confirm PR number before wire release.
nora: Noted. I'll standby to approve wire once KYC and PR are attached.
maria: Thanks team — looping back after acquirer check (jon).
